name: Curly Kale
title: Curly Kale (Brassica oleracea var. sabellica)
description: Cold temperature stress elicitation, anthocyanin accumulation, and vertical farm LED light spectrum optimization for nutrient density.
summary: High-density nutrient-rich Brassica cultivar requiring cold DIF steering, glucosinolate enhancement, and controlled boundary layer micro-airflow.

steering.generative: Increase EC to 2.4 dS/m, lower night temperature to 12°C (DIF +8°C) to induce cold-stress anthocyanin and glucoraphanin synthesis.
steering.vegetative: Maintain EC 1.8 dS/m, RH 70% (VPD 0.85 kPa), 18h photoperiod under 25% Blue LED spectrum for leaf expansion.
